source.source_locator: 危険物の規制に関する政令 第24条第13号

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 可燃性液体・蒸気等の漏えい滞留のおそれがある場所では完全な電気接続とし、火花発生源を使用しない。
evidence.tested_misconception: 裸火だけ避ければ火花を発する工具は使用できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: flammable vapor risk -> secure electrical connections -> eliminate spark sources

collision.note: B3 Tier A; vapor/spark causal safety boundary.

independent_review.rationale: Conditional vapor-risk electrical/spark rule is more specific than the general fire prohibition.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 22 accepted candidates test concrete storage and handling duties, quantitative boundaries, Class-4-specific controls, or explicit sale/record obligations without material collision with the 29 canonical Otsu4 questions. C016 and C017 are too abstract to add sufficient practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
